newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends mostly higher on commercial buying.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends mostly higher on commercial buying.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended mostly higher on commercial buying, traders said.

"There was crusher short covering in the July at the close and farmers were delivering in August and September, commercials bought November," a trader said. July WCE futures crush margin rose to +0.38 Thursday from -3.74 Wednesday. About 500 Aug-Nov spread from $13 to $7, Cargill bought 500 Aug-Jan at $3.50 from UGG, Sep-Nov $0.50.
July rose $1.70 to $362.70 after it set a new low of $355.20, August lost $4.90 to $348 after it set a new low of $347.50, November rose $1.80 to $341.
RBC-DS bought July flax up $2.80 to $328.50 after it set a new low of $321, Cargill bought September down $2 to $289 after it set a new low of $288.
July western barley rose $2.20 to $122.70 on commercial demand at the close, October up $0.60 to $125.60. UGG bought 37 July-Oct at $4.20. Volume was 650 lots.

July feed wheat fell $3 to $146 on long liquidation after setting a new low of $145.50, October lost $1.10 to $152 as Alberta Wheat Pool sold after it set a new low of $151.50. About 120 July-Oct $4. Volume was 400.
PCTS sold December and February feed peas down US$4.80.
December peas fell to US$167.20, February dropped to $169.20, new contract lows. Pea volume was 125. Oats did not trade.
(All values in Canadian dollars except oats, peas.)
